summary: Task C — the tests a SCOPED job owes: referencing tests, capped, never the whole suite at SCOPED/DIRECT

tests.command:
/usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-preeval.py --selftest
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-fastpath-run.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/compound-v-fastpath-run.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f tests/v2.9-e2e/test_fastpath_and_escalation.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest tests/v2.9-e2e/test_fastpath_and_escalation.py'
bash -c 'for s in scripts/compound-v-preeval.py scripts/compound-v-localize.py scripts/compound-v-taxonomy.py scripts/compound-v-validate-taxonomy.py scripts/compound-v-fastpath-run.py scripts/compound-v-classify-request.py scripts/compound-v-validate-manifest.py; do /usr/bin/python3 -B "$s" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $s"; exit 1; }; done; for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/v2.9-e2e -p "test_*.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL e2e"; exit 1; }; echo all-tests-ok'
